formulas.ascii: r = S_xy / sqrt(S_xx S_yy) over the N listed pairs i < j, x = spatial distance, y = |t_i - t_j|; S_xy = sum xy - sum x sum y / N, S_xx = sum xx - (sum x)^2 / N, S_yy likewise. r = 0 when N <= 1 or a variance is 0. p = (1 + #{permutations s with r_s >= r}) / (P + 1): one-sided (positive space-time correlation), +1 counts the observed value, ties count as exceedances.
